statement: Remove the two durable progress writes whose information is retained elsewhere from every write transaction's path, at their single producers: (a) the ACTIVE row on sql_transaction_participants written at the first write to each table (the manifest on sql_transactions, appended before any participant request, is the admitted set; the participant's in-memory ACTIVE transition stays), and (b) the status = PREPARED update on sql_transactions between the PREPARED participant rows and the decision (recovery restores a FROZEN undecided row as PREPARING and decides from the participant rows' evidence). The live recovery sweep chooses the commit protocol for an undecided live transaction from the commit-point fact or COMMITTING instead of the PREPARED label. A write transaction then submits 5 + 3P coordinator-table writes on COMMIT (from 6 + 4P) and 5 + 2P on ROLLBACK (from 5 + 3P), and waits for up to P + 1 fewer consensus rounds; every crash point still ends in exactly one recorded outcome applied by every participant, with no orphaned participant session.

constraints.statement: The exact OPEN-row manifest compare-and-set stays the first durable act for every participant and precedes its BEGIN, QUERY or write; recovery derives the admitted set from the manifest alone and reads a missing participant row as a member without evidence.

Every participant's PREPARED row with prepared_digest, prepare_index and prepare_term is durably persisted before a COMMIT decision is recorded (sealed constraints preserve-two-phase-decision-protocol and preserve-cas-and-prepared-evidence-authority stay in force).
A participant already begun in a transaction is never begun again: the in-memory participant transition to ACTIVE is kept when its durable row is removed.

The live recovery sweep continues the commit protocol for an undecided transaction only when its commit point is reached or its status is COMMITTING, and otherwise runs the rollback protocol; no decision is inferred from a progress label.

Each write is deleted at its one producer; no flag, mode, alias, elided placeholder write or second path is introduced. Readers of durable rows keep accepting rows that earlier builds wrote (the release census contract tx1-query-set-v1 is not changed).

Every changed assertion of a closed or open quest's witness or probe (fast-path guard priority 1 and its witness tests, the TX1 leg-a and restart hold points, the tx-metadata counts, the participant-set overlap and Finding 1B witnesses) is named in a supersession finding in this quest with the original record; closed records stay untouched.
The recovery witnesses in test/query/transaction-redundant-progress-writes-recovery.test.js and the guard's preservation properties stay green and are not weakened.
Every source attempt requires independent verification newer than the attempt, recorded with verifier subagent:<id>, before landing.
